reviews.text: Well done!!!

I had a cardiac ultrasound on my dog. I was told I'd receive the results once I left, but nothing... I waited three days and called back in the next four. Each time I called, I was told they'd send it once the call was finished, but nothing. Today, the last call in which they rudely told me that the results aren't given immediately but that you have to wait 10 days, without apologizing, but offering excuses. I won't add anything else. They were completely rude and impolite, with miscommunications, and the office where the examination takes place is full of boxes and messy. Absolutely to be avoided, even if the doctor was professional and scrupulous. What a shame.

My cat lost an eye. A Persian. Reported. If she survives, I'll bring her in and see what they say. They gave her a cortisone that wasn't needed. She was taken to the Borghesiana clinic. Let's hope she lives. A Persian!

Fantastic!
Experience, professionalism, expertise, and above all, passion.
Dr. Russo is exceptional.
I can say that I had a great time, they are all very competent, very good and welcoming, honest above all, I recommend them, I have changed many vets... they are truly the best...
The entire team is very helpful, knowledgeable, and welcoming to our beloved furry friends! Giorgia, in particular, is very empathetic and professional! Highly recommended.

Professionalism, kindness, helpfulness—what else?
Their little patients are satisfied.

I'm only now responding to the medical director of this, for me, useless facility. Dear genius, I'll tell you that if I had a vet in the area (unfortunately mine is in Parioli), I certainly wouldn't have come to you to waste my time paying for your superficiality and lack of professionalism. I reiterate that I didn't believe you were a pet shop, otherwise I wouldn't have come to you. Also learn to be united. From your answers, it doesn't seem to me that you are polite and humble. You should TREAT dogs, not allow yourselves to judge their owners! I hope I've been clear!

Empathy zero, they have no tact with animals; to them, it's just money.
I've only been there once for an X-ray of my dog. I thought I'd be watching the anesthetic injection, but instead they forced the door open, grabbed my dog, dragged her in, and locked her in a room with them. She managed to escape and return to the entrance, leaving a trail of feces behind her. She's always been scared at the vet, but never like this, and above all, you asked to come in since she has fear management issues, being wary and fearful, and we're undergoing training, due to her violent past. I'll never go back, that's for sure. If you don't know how to treat animals, as the reviews below boast (at this point I think they're written by your friends), change your career.
Very professional, and very honest.

The vet we've been taking our dogs to for a while now is very professional and kind, and I might add, a great sense of humanity. I say this, unfortunately, because we recently had to put one of our big dogs down because he was in too much pain.
Truly kind people, as well as professionals of a high standard.
Dr. Pietro Russo and his team have been following my dogs for many years, they are my salvation, kind, friendly and professional, without them I wouldn't know what to do, thank you ❤️
Professional and meticulous. Passionate and caring, and fair prices. A guarantee for the health of my furry friends. Highly recommended.
Trained and professional staff. What would I do without them? 💗 Thank you! …
Qualified staff, they are all really good and competent!

I went to this veterinary practice for my dog's care, and the experience was extremely positive. The team was helpful and very attentive. They handled the visit with professionalism, the right solution, clearly explaining every step and always putting my dog's well-being first.
I particularly appreciated the care taken in their treatment and their ability to instill peace of mind for both the animal and the owner. The facility was clean.
I highly recommend this vet to anyone looking for reliability, experience, and a humane and respectful approach.
Always make an appointment, because the office is really too small, and there are only a few of them.

Excellent and caring doctors and assistants! I arrived without an appointment because I'd found my cat missing for 36 hours in terrible condition and unable to eat or drink. She was immediately examined and given blood tests. For the next three days, she received full-time care with IVs and constant monitoring, and I only paid for the first-day visit and tests. They cared for me meticulously, providing me with precise instructions every day and upon discharge. They are very kind and generous people. I recommend them and will return to them for any problems my cats have.
Qualified, friendly, and always available staff. They're all competent and, above all, empathetic.
Very kind and very prepared

I was incredibly lucky to find this veterinary practice by chance, with very competent doctors who know how to listen to both humans and our friends, all very kind and reassuring. In December 2024 I had given up on my elderly cat, but with the intervention of Dr. Giorgia and the gastroenterologist Chiara they literally saved her life and now she is in excellent health.

Nothing to complain about so far: kind, helpful.
Great prices, which never hurts.
The doctors are helpful and kind. So far, I'm doing very well.
The number ones

What can you say when you're diagnosed with a curable disease and then the dog dies of something completely different? She was treated for MYASTHENIA GRAVIS for a month. They said, "She'll walk again," but then she got worse every day. I sought a consultation at the ROMA SUD VETERINARY CLINIC, where they diagnosed her with a tumor, a compromised liver, and collapsed lungs, and that was the end. It's not difficult to be kind, but upon hearing the news of my partner's death, the vet at GREEN VET simply said, "I'm so sorry," without asking how or why. For me, it was tragic.

I wish all vets were like this! A special mention goes to Dr. Pietro Russo, with whom I've had the opportunity to interact several times regarding my elderly cat. He's a kind, professional, empathetic, honest, and helpful person whom I recommend to everyone! The staff is also always very efficient and helpful!
Very good and honest
Professionalism and helpfulness. Definitely a five-star veterinary practice.
Professional and kind... always available!!!
Great availability and humanity, excellent transversal skills among the various veterinarians: Pietro, Giorgio and Giorgia.
My dog ​​is scared. My dog ​​loves them.
Excellent professionals
Very helpful, courteous, and friendly (I asked for help giving my dog ​​some shots): absolutely not to be taken for granted, and for that I thank them.
Loving and competent veterinarians
They are reliable, competent people and above all they have a humanity that prevents them from being thieves unlike others.
Family atmosphere, everyone is very kind from the doctors to the girls who act as assistants
Friendliness and competence. Recommended!!
Courteous, kind, and friendly staff. They've always taken the utmost care of my pets, and I've never had to wait long, not after a phone call or at the office. Highly recommended.

The doctors, nurses, and staff are extremely competent and helpful. They are attentive to the dog's needs and understanding of the owners. In difficult times, it's truly a relief to know I can count on their professionalism. Extremely clean and well-organized. We feel safe with them. My dogs are grateful, and so am I.

My elderly cocker spaniel and I have been coming to this doctor's office often lately. The staff is knowledgeable, professional, and helpful.
Dr. Giorgio is a guarantee.

I must say I was shocked when the doctor called me to give me an update on the cat she suspected had partial epilepsy. I want to say I truly appreciate this call, and it's clear that Greenvet and the team work with love!
It was my first time at this clinic, but now I am and will be a customer forever.
I recommend it to everyone!
Angela, truly knowledgeable and very sweet with my Maltese. Thank you.
Beautiful facility. Young and empathetic doctors. Highly recommended!
